source_policy.guard: same public Registry JSON metadata-only rules, CAS bytes exactly equal pinned source, prior hash/path exclusions, native holdout exclusions, explicit denial and pinned quarantine, fixed split
source_policy.replay: fresh parent-correct replay preferred; if insufficient, revalidate only exact R122 train receipts, no prior gate or exam reuse; no split reassignment; 12 replay, 12 fresh gate, 12 fresh exam; fail closed if insufficient

design.reward: all arms perform exact full-vocabulary terminated answer generation on 80 internal gate prompts per probe; prohibit any loss of previously correct gate item; same prior pair/open/historical veto, geometry, nontrivial step and current CE gain; cold CE uses feasible CE gain; both epistemic arms use count of newly exact correct items + .49*gain/(1+gain); separate exact acquisition steps and CE-only steps
design.inheritance: recompute two R122 calibrated histories from zero over 180 trials each, verify stored before/after errors and final scalars; mean final errors transferred into inherited arm, no old checkpoint weights or exam labels; cold arms start at zero; compare first 30 decisions and entire run on new seeds
design.probes: same paired actual AdamW candidate evaluation, restore both model and optimizer after each probe, commit at most one exactly sealed candidate; all arms prechoose before current outcomes and update online error
design.evaluation: report acquisition steps vs CE-only, exact gate item gains and losses, cold/warm prequential ranking early/all, new held-out exact generation and old pair/open/historical losses; all six candidates subject to unchanged final criteria; no promotion

limits: G8 corpus growth not proof of newly admitted examples; original admission policy unchanged except audited second pinned origin snapshot and explicit training-only replay reuse
Warm start transfers CE-share error to epistemic reward, not an established compatible learned policy; compare cold and inherited on new seeds only
Exact gate generation is internal repeated feedback, not proof of generalized skill; final exam separate, no external independent blind exam
CE-only admissible updates remain allowed as auxiliary progress, not knowledge acquisition
Different reward scales prohibit cross-reward regret comparison; autoregressive stopping makes compute not exactly equal despite matched prompt budget
No production change, model export or promotion
